transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the pre-movement load-planning review for tomorrow's 1600 convoy. We've got one heavy trailer with front, center, and rear positions to fill with the communications shelter, water tank module, and generator module. The draft manifest lists all three items but doesn't assign positions yet. I need each of you to report any updates from your lane — measurements, placement requirements, or maintenance status — and make sure you enter them as formal fact-update entries on the movement board. I'll verify those entries before we approve the board. Let's start with the loadmaster — what are you seeing on your end?

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I have a critical update from my lane. I reweighed the communications shelter this morning and confirmed it is 8,400 pounds, not the 6,000 pounds shown on the draft manifest. Due to the corrected weight, the communications shelter must be placed in the center position for axle balance, and an axle-balance check must be completed before the trailer is released. I'm entering this as a formal fact-update on the movement board now. I also want to flag that the corrected scale ticket has not yet been attached to the movement packet — I'll get that done before we finalize.

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I have a critical update from my lane. I confirmed with the receiving site that the water tank's vent cap raises its loaded height to 13 feet, while the approved access structure allows only 12 feet 6 inches. The vent cap must be removed and secured before movement. Additionally, the water tank must use the front position so the rear approach remains clear for the generator's loading equipment, and a pre-dispatch height check must be completed. I'm entering this as a formal fact-update on the movement board now.

During this morning's inspection, I found that the generator module's lifting eye is not serviceable, so it must be loaded with the side-forklift rather than the trailer crane. The rear position is required for the side-forklift approach. Additionally, the only qualified forklift crew is booked at 1400 tomorrow — that's two hours before the 1600 convoy departure, so we need to factor that into the timeline. I'm entering this as a formal fact-update on the movement board now: generator module to the rear position, side-forklift loading required, forklift crew scheduled for 1400.
